source_read: https://tkmenus.com/thechaptercollection, eleven September 2026 menus (?mguid=...: main, bar snacks, steak, lunch, Sunday, brunch, dessert, non gluten containing ingredient, kids, kids Sunday, drinks), downloaded 2026-10-11 (sha256 prefixes: main 1b08abfaca3e7b12, barsnacks 2334640d176dba7a, steak 9dc8e5bd2bf6dbd7, lunch 26fc1ec66280177c, sunday a44644ddd10b6cbe, brunch 65b0da28d129444e, dessert 1cfa08696f08a04b, nogluten 0c47986cdcaffded, kids ce8b4b7cb39dc526, kidssunday 57154b41a4cca2cd, drinks 12527fb8f7dd31fa); linked from https://www.thechaptercollection.co.uk/menus (View Allergens); robots.txt of tkmenus.com disallows only /fonts/, /views/, /*.less$; site count: six pubs on https://www.thechaptercollection.co.uk/our-chapter-collection-sites (Blue Anchor Hammersmith, Bonds Mayfair, Rocket Canary Wharf, The Duchess of Duke Street, Marquis of Westminster, Lillie Langtry)
not_verifiable: whether every pub serves every menu (the page says nothing either way; one menu set for the brand)
notes: All 172 written items (163 published + 9 held back) re-read with a different method from the extractor: a plain text-line parser over the saved pages (dish line, '(N kcal)' line, 'Dietary info:' Contains / may also contain lines, 'Nutritional info:' block) instead of tenkites_b's HTML tree reader. All eight printed figures (kcal, kJ, protein, carbs, sugars, fat, saturates, salt) matched for every item, and the 14-allergen contains / may-contain sets matched for every item. Fixed in the script: 'Lamb Pave Steak' had been tagged beef from the word 'steak' (now no tag). Held back: Chicken Wings (759 kcal vs 1,836 kJ and macros of about 493 kcal), N'duja & Pork Sausage Roll, Ultimate Cheese Toastie (V) and Spicy Coated Chicken Burger (kcal disagrees with both their kJ and their macros, which agree with each other), Crodino Spritz 0% and Hartridges Apple & Mango (kJ about ten times the kcal), Mini Fish & Chips (no gluten marked), Chickpea Hummus (VG) (no sesame marked) and the kids' Chocolate Brownie (VG-M) (no gluten marked, not on the no-gluten menu). Left out: 124 alcoholic drinks (125 rows; founder's rule of 11 Oct 2026; they print '-' for every figure anyway), 182 hot-drink rows (coffee or tea printed without its milk), the Bites & Buns sharing platters (2 rows on the no-gluten menu; the Bites & Buns menu itself not read), festive, set, meeting-package, June 2026 and MIXR menus.
